phase: Accounting Empirical Recovery / F2 Phase C2 — F21 External Instrument Bridge
purpose: Test whether holder-specific external F21 currency can be identified exactly from QSA total F2 minus the already materialized F2M deposits component.
identity: F2 = F21 + F2M, therefore W1 F21(holder) = W1 F2(holder) - W1 F2M(holder) when definitions and dimensions are identical.

inputs.F2M_external_cells_status: DERIVED by previously passed exact QSA complement gate
inputs.candidate_F2_source: ECB QSA W1 assets by resident holder
inputs.F21_holder_control: ECB QSA W0 F21 assets by resident holder

promotion_rule: Only if every resident-holder W1 F2 series is available and all exact bridge controls pass for stock and flow may holder-specific external F21 be eligible for later materialization. This gate does not itself assign the resident issuer column or populate total F2.
failure_rule: If any holder W1 F2 series is unavailable, definitionally mismatched, or the aggregate identities fail, F21 remains unresolved. No aggregate W1 F21 amount may be distributed by shares.
system_dynamics_conformity: Accounting-only gate; feedback and behavioural closure remain unchanged.
